cpu.training_tokens_sum_scope: sum of recorded training tokens; missing observations are not measured zero-token runs

npu.training_tokens_sum_scope: sum of recorded training tokens; missing observations are not measured zero-token runs

concurrency.scope: observed main worker intervals including child restore; interval end is exclusive; not a contention or isolation comparison

data_manifest.holdout_label: pilot article holdout from upstream train; not official validation or test

split_policy.hash: sha256 of utf8 article content; salted hash threshold
split_policy.preamble_policy: nonempty text preceding first title is one document

tokenizer.eos_policy: one EOS appended per complete document; no BOS prepended

training.cap_policy: first train articles until target reached; final article remains whole

failures.message: allocation multiplier did not meet the total constraint

limitations: 本轮没有独占运行与并发运行的配对比较；重叠区间证明同时执行的事实，不能证明并发无吞吐损失或同卡并发能力。
吞吐来自各任务实际配置与并发环境；不同参数量、batch、序列长度和算子路径不可据此直接排名架构效率。
验证数据是 WikiText 上游训练文章的固定试运行留出；每次仅有少量样本，验证损失变化不构成模型质量排名。
执行完成、浮点容差、结构/整数检查、checkpoint 数据、输入流与 RNG 恢复分别报告；缺失阶段保持 unknown。
已保存的恢复比较仅覆盖记录的 logits、梯度、参数、优化器及私有状态；不外推全部组合、尺度或后端。
因果探针仅在初始化、空私有状态下使用 1 个 16-token 样本，改动后 8 个 token 并比较前 8 个 logits；不认证训练后或其他状态、长度及 batch 的因果性。
恢复梯度在全局范数裁剪后捕获；其一致性不等同于未裁剪梯度一致性。
参数变化与最后一步非 None 梯度不能证明每个模块有效学习；参数变化可能包含 AdamW weight decay，零梯度与未连通梯度也需分别解释。
活动量来自 B=1、空初始状态探针的聚合计数；它不认证完整离散轨迹或训练全程活动量。
当前 resume-verify 仅检查新进程的一次实际优化器更新及私有状态延续，尚非长程断点任务队列功能。
训练前失败的任务没有可测训练吞吐，也没有恢复资格；缺测保留 unknown，不作为 0 吞吐参与统计。
训练吞吐按 worker 的测量边界统计；推理为驻留模型、包含任务头的真实文本 teacher-forced 继续，排除分词与主机传输。

acceptance.execution: finite training and measurable inference when budget permits
acceptance.limits: finite numerical disagreement retained separately; causal/nonfinite/execution errors fail the affected task
acceptance.recovery: exact saved data/data stream/RNG; original atol1e-5 rtol1e-4 for floating outputs, gradients, state and updates; integer metadata exact

plan.comparison_policy: fixed seed/data sampler within matching workload; baselines are capacity references, not claimed exact parameter matches
plan.data_policy: WikiText103 upstream train, article hash holdout, train-only byte BPE8192
plan.learning_rate_policy: linear 10-step warmup then constant 3e-4; resumable without changing horizon
plan.precision_policy: FP32 parameters/arithmetic/optimizer; no AMP in first pilot
plan.purpose: mechanism, cost, finite learning and continuation calibration; not a tuned quality ranking
plan.retention: latest application checkpoint per task; failed recovery reference and actual update; successful comparison payloads removed after metrics saved
plan.timed_readout: last tick before the next external input; no flush inserted between windows
